notes.text: Available in cPanel 82 and later. Returns a list of recommended PHP version names; an empty list is preserved. Recommendations do not change the server configuration.

evidence.note: /EA4/get_php_recommendations declares x-readonly: true and a GET operation. Pinned UAPI gzip SHA-256: 172660ce0d8e0868756dabf8e3243ea41399aac7bff06082d806c73f71a094fc.

notes.text: Available in cPanel 84 and later. Package names are dynamic keys whose values are recommendation lists. Recommendation and option fields remain optional; empty maps and lists remain empty.
Option recommended values are booleans. UI levels and action strings stay strings; no additional closed enum or inferred version support is imposed.

Direct UAPI returned boolean and string outer recommendation url values on cPanel 11.138.0.19. Preserve bool|string without inferring a false-only sentinel; option-level URLs remain strings. The failed WHM bridge envelope establishes no successful bridged payload behavior.
